channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Wilson airport left without fuel as operator halts services
item.description: Wilson Industrial Air Center lost fuel service when Carolina Air Center abruptly ended its fixed-base operator contract Jan. 9.

item.title: King’s dream was never finished
item.description: Martin Luther King Jr.’s dream was never meant as a holiday relic but an unfinished call to active, everyday justice — from racial equality to economic fairness, care and restorative change.

item.title: NC enjoys status as destination state, but not for business lawsuits
item.description: North Carolina’s Supreme Court may soon decide if out-of-state companies registered to do business here can be sued in state courts on claims with no ties to North Carolina.

item.title: The North Carolina GOP and its fear of voters
item.description: How North Carolina’s Trump-aligned GOP has repeatedly moved to weaken powers of elected Democrats, entrench control through gerrymandering and power grabs and sidestep voters’ choices.

item.title: What it means to live on minimum wage in NC
item.description: North Carolina hasn’t raised its minimum wage since 2009, and it’s still stuck at the federal minimum. It’s beyond time the state stepped up for its workers.

item.title: Wilson shoppers paying it forward
item.description: At a Food Lion store in Wilson, a man with his family gave $40 each to two strangers in line, who chose to pay it forward — one anonymously passing the money along to a veteran.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 21-22, 2026
item.description: Area high school sports schedule for Jan. 21-22, 2026, featuring boys and girls basketball, JV games, wrestling and swimming matchups across multiple local schools.

item.title: Eagles’ strong finish can’t overcome weak start in loss to Warriors
item.description: Despite a 21-5 fourth-quarter surge, Sallie B. Howard fell 63-54 to North Edgecombe, remaining winless in ECAC play as the Warriors improved to 3-0 and share the conference lead.

item.title: Sallie B girls stop North Edgecombe in OT, 45-40
item.description: Sallie B. Howard girls rally from eight down in the fourth to edge North Edgecombe 45-40 in OT, led by Uriyjah Chance’s 12 points despite 3-for-23 free-throw shooting in ECAC play.

item.title: Hunt girls work OT to pay Fike back, 59-55
item.description: Deoni Artis' 22 points and overtime heroics lifted Hunt past rival Fike 59-55, avenging a holiday tourney loss and pulling the Warriors out of the Big East basement.
